purpose: Reconstruct a spatially uniform MACS J1206 BCG cube from the six central-pointing 095.A-0181(A) level-2 products, avoiding the east/west pointing boundary in the public level-3 mosaic.
selection_rule: Select every public calibrated MUSE cube from proposal 095.A-0181(A) whose footprint fully contains the published BCG plus the 12-arcsec semimajor extraction ellipse. Selection uses archive geometry only, not a kinematic result.

coadd_protocol.spatial_method: register the fixed-n, fixed-q, fixed-PA BCG continuum model independently in each cube and extract the same sky-oriented elliptical annuli; do not image-coadd the offset pixel grids
coadd_protocol.spectral_grid: intersection of the six observed wavelength grids at the median native step
coadd_protocol.spectral_resampling: linear flux and conservative linear variance interpolation onto the common grid
coadd_protocol.coadd_weighting: inverse propagated variance after per-spectrum continuum normalization
coadd_protocol.outer_systematic_check: repeat the outermost full-annulus and opposite-half fits six times, omitting one product at a time
